content: Yesu lɔ́yɔ mʋ tɔ́ɩsʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Akʋ bʋbʋ mlɩtɔ nfɩ bʋmóowu, yɔ́fʋn brɛ́á bawun ánɩ́ Bulu iwíegyí amʋ ɩna túmisʋ ɩbá.”
Yesu Ɩwɩtsɛ́ɛ
Nkensíé ɔma a, Yesu lɛ́kpa Petro, Yakobo mʋa Yohane, mʋa amʋ́nyɔ bɔdʋ yɔ́ ɩbʋ kʋsʋ amʋ́ nkʋlɛ. Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́tsɛ amʋ́ ansɩ́tɔ́.
Mʋ atadɩɛ lɛdamlí futútúútú, ɩdɛ ogyá kpa. Tɔtɔ ma ɔsʋlʋ́ʋ anfɩsʋá ɩbɛ́talɩ́ bwɛ́ mʋ́ ibófulí alɩ.
Ɩnʋ Elia mʋa Mose bɛlɛ ɩwɩ ɔwan, amʋ́a Yesu bʋdɛtɔɩ́.
Mʋ́ʋ́ Petro lɛ́bláa Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Osunápʋ́, ɩbʋ alɛ́á abétsiá nfɩ. Ha ada abú asa. Fʋ́ klɛ́ kʋlɛ, Mose klɛ́ kʋlɛ, Elia ɛ́ klɛ́ kʋlɛ.”
Ifú lɛhɩɛ kɩ́tá Petro mʋa mʋ aba ámʋ dʋbɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ omowun asʋ́n ánɩ́ ɔblɩ́ɩ.
Ɩnʋ agyinde kʋ lobobun amʋ́sʋ́, ɔmɛ kʋ lɛdalɩ tsu mʋ́tɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔ́nɩ gyí mɩ́ Bí ɔdwɛpʋ́ nɩ́! Mlɩyaa asʋ amlɩnu mʋ asʋ́n!”
Ɩnʋ bɛlakɩ, támɛ bʋmɛtrá wun ɔhaa dʋn Yesu nkʋlɛ.
Brɛ́á bʋdɛ ɩbʋ ámʋ kplɩ́ á, Yesu lɛ́da amʋ́ ɔlá ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mábláa ɔhaa tɔ́á bayówun, yɔ́fʋn ɛkɛá Bulu ɔbɔ́kʋsʋ́a mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ tsú afúlitɔ.”
Asʋ́n ánfɩ lesin amʋ́ nwuntɔ, betsiá fɩ́tɛ́ aba bɛɛ, “Kʋsʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ ánfɩ asɩ mɛ́?”
Ɩnʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ Yesu bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ amʋ bɛɛ, ilehián ánɩ́ Elia obéyinkí bá asa Kristo amʋ ɔbɛ́ba?”

Ɔlɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ igyi, ánɩ́ Elia obégyankpá bá bɛla tógyítɔ́ yáɩ́ wankláán. Mʋ́ ntogyi sʋ́ Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ kɛ́n lɛ́blɩ́ tsú mɩ́ ɩwɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ nɛ́hɩɛ wun ipian, ahá bɔ́sʋpáa mɩ?
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, Elia layínkí bá dodo. Ahá bɔbwɛ mʋ alɩá bʋdeklé, fɛ́ alɩá bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ.”
Ɩlɔ Dɩ́dahɛ Ɔlɔpʋ́ Tsa
Brɛ́á beyinkí bowie akasɩ́pʋ́ atráhɛ amʋ wá á, bowun ánɩ́ ɔdɔm kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩ bafia bomlí amʋ́, Mose mbla asunápʋ́ akʋ bʋdɛ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ nwɛ́ɛn gyí.
Brɛ́á ɔdɔm amʋ bowun Yesu a, ɩlɔwa amʋ́ wánwan, bɛsrɩ́ yéfia mʋ, há mʋ ayɛ.
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Amansʋ mlɩa amʋ́nyɔ mlɩdɛ́bɩtɩ́?”
Ɔdɔm amʋtɔ ɔkʋ lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Osunápʋ́, nɛkpa mɩ́ bí yínhɛ́ ba fʋ mbɛ́ɛ afʋtsa mʋ ɩlɔ. Ɔŋɛ laláhɛ lahá ɔtamatɔ́ɩ́.

Brégyíbrɛ́á ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ ɩba mʋsʋ á, ɩtɔwʋ́sʋ mʋ, fɩn mʋ dá ɔsʋlʋ́tɔ. Mʋ ɔnɔ́ tɔbwɛ́ afu, ɔtɔwɩ́ ayín, ɔtɛsɩ́nsɩn. Nɛbláa fʋ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ mbɛ́ɛ, bʋgyáa ɔŋɛ́ ámʋ lɛ mʋtɔ ha mɩ, támɛ bʋmɛtalɩ́.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ndɛmba-abíá mlɩmá hógyi, alɩ́ nétsiá mlɩ wá yɔ́ nɩ́? Yɔ́fʋn ɔmɛnkɛ nnyá klʋn ha mlɩ? Mlɩkpa kebi ámʋ ba mɩ!”
Bɛkpa kebi ámʋ ba Yesu. Ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ lénya wun Yesu alɩ, ɩlɔwʋsʋ́ʋ kebi ámʋ fɩn mʋ dá. Odemináa, mʋ ɔnɔ́ ɛ́ ɩdɛ afu.
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ obí mʋ sɩ ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Tsú brɛ́ mɔmʋtɔ ɩlɔ ánfɩ lefi asɩ?” Ɔlɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Tsú mʋ nyebitɔ ɔpá.
Ɩtɔtswɩ mʋ wá ogyá mʋ́a ntsu aná fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́, itekleá ɩbɔ́mɔ mʋ, támɛ nɩ́ fɛ́talɩ́ bwɛ́ tɔkʋ tsú mʋ́ ɩwɩ á, wun anɩ nwɛ afʋgyi anɩ bʋalɛ.”
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Blɩ́ fʋdɛ fɛɛ, nɩ́ nɛ́talɩ́? Tógyítɔ́ lɔpɔn ha ohógyipʋ.”
Ɩnʋ obí mʋ sɩ ámʋ lɔ́kplʋn blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nohogyi, támɛ mɩ́ hógyi mɔtsɔ́. Gyi mɩ bʋalɛ, mɩ́ hógyi imoní!”
Brɛ́á Yesu lówun ánɩ́ ɔdɔm amʋ bʋtráa bʋsrɩ́ bɛbá á, ɔlɔkplʋ́n wa ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́ ɔdandʋbiabía mʋ́a ɩsʋtín ɔŋɛ́, dalɩ kebi ámʋtɔ. Mátrá wie mʋtɔ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ!”
Ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ lɔ́sʋrá okitikíti kʋ́klʋ́kʋ́ʋ́, ɩlɛtrá wʋsʋ́ʋ mʋ nyányányányáa, ɩlɛdalɩ mʋtɔ. Ɔŋɛ́ lɛta mʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ ahá ámʋtɔ akʋ bɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, “Alawú.”
Támɛ Yesu lɛ́kɩtá mʋ ɩbɩ tsú mʋ fʋ́á, ɔlɔkʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́.
Mʋ́ ɔma, brɛ́á Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ nkʋlɛ bʋbʋ wóyítɔ́ a, bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ anɩ mʋ́ anɩmɛ́talɩ́ gya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ dálɩ kebi ámʋtɔ?”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩ́nɩ odu mʋ́ á, nkɛ́tɩ mpáɩ
pɛ́ mlɛ́talɩ́ pʋ́gya mʋ́.”
Yesu Lowu Ɩwɩ Asʋ́n Blɩ́ Otse Nyɔɔsɩ
Brɛ́á Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛnatɩ́ ɩnʋ á, bɔtsʋn Galilea ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ, támɛ Yesu mékléá ɔhaa ɔbɩ́ɩ ɔtɩ́nɛ́á mʋbʋ.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔdɛ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ atɔ́ suná ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bɛ́lɛ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ há adʋ́n bɔ́mɔ mɩ́, támɛ Bulu ɔbɛ́lakʋ́sʋ́a mɩ ɛkɛ sáásɩ́.”
Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bʋmonu mʋ́ asɩ, ifú ɛ́ dɛ amʋ́ ánɩ́ bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ.
Ma Ɔbɔ́bwɛ Ɔhandɛ?
Bɛba Kapernaum wúlutɔ. Brɛ́á bowie wóyítɔ́ á, Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntɔ nwɛ́ɛn mlɩdégyí ɔkpatɔ?”
Bɛkpa ɔnɔ́ bun mʋ́sʋ́, tsúfɛ́ ɩhandɛ bʋdɛprɩ́ɩ.
Yesu létsiá asɩ, ɔlɛtɩ akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋ, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ mlɩtɔ ɔkʋ dékléá ɔbɔ́bwɛ mlɩ nkpá ogyápʋ a, ɔbwɛ́ɛ mʋ ɩwɩ ɔma ogyápʋ pʋ́ mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ osúmpʋ́.”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛkpa kebi ɔkʋ bɛlɩɩ́ amʋ́ ansɩ́tɔ́, látá mʋ pútá, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ ɔlɔhɔ kebiá ogyi alɩ mɩ́ dátɔ́ lahɔ mɩ. Ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ ɔhɔ mɩ á, megyí mɩ́ ɔlɔhɔ, mboún ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɔwa mɩ́ ámʋ.”
Anɩ Obúopʋ
Yohane lɛ́bláa Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Osunápʋ́, anɩlówun oyin ɔkʋ dɛ́pʋ fʋ́ dá gya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ, anɩlɛ́ka mʋ tin, tsúfɛ́ ɔma anɩtɔ.”
Támɛ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩmáka mʋ itin! Tsúfɛ́ ɔhaa má ɩnʋá ɔbɔ́bwɛ ofúla mɩ́ dátɔ́, láblɩ́ mɩ́ ɩwɩ asʋn laláhɛ.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔmɔkʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ anɩsʋ buo anɩ.
Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɔhá mlɩ ntsu-owebi mlonu, mɩ́ dá ánɩ́ ɩdɩn mlɩsʋ sʋ á, ɔmɔ́ɔhʋlɩ́ɩ mʋ ɩpán.
Ɔha Kpa Wá Lakpantɔ
“Nɩ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́ha ahá ánfɩ bʋmɔkʋ́dan mɩ́sʋ́ hógyitɔ ánfɩtɔ ɔkʋ lɔ́bwɛ lakpan á, nɩ́ bɛda nfúókwɛbʋ síán mʋ ɔmɛtɔ, tswɩ mʋ wá ɔpʋtɔ pó á, ɩbʋ alɛ́ dʋn.
Nɩ́ fʋ́ ɩbɩ kʋlɛ tɛ́há fʋ́tɔbwɛ́ lakpan á, ka mʋ́ lɛ! Ɩbʋ alɛ́á fɔ́pʋ ɩbɩ kʋlɛ nyá nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá, dʋn ánɩ́ fɔ́pʋ ɩbɩ anyɔ wíé ɩsʋbɩtɩ́ ogyá ánɩ́ ɩtamaduntɔ.
Nɩ́ fʋ́ yabi kʋlɛ tɛ́há fʋ́tɔbwɛ́ lakpan á, ka mʋ́ tswɩ tsalɩfwɩ! Ɩbʋ alɛ́á fɔ́pʋ yabi kʋlɛ nyá nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá, dʋn ánɩ́ fɔ́pʋ ayabi anyɔ wíé ɩsʋbɩtɩ́ ogyá ánɩ́ ɩtamaduntɔ.
Nɩ́ fʋ́ nsíbi tɛ́há fʋ́tɔbwɛ́ lakpan á, loti mʋ́ lɛ. Ɩbʋ alɛ́á fɔ́pʋ nsibi kʋlɛ wíé Bulu iwíegyí ámʋtɔ, dʋn ánɩ́ fɔ́pʋ ansibi anyɔ wíé ɩsʋbɩtɩ́ ogyá ánɩ́ ɩtamaduntɔ.
Ɔtɩ́nɛ́á ɩnʋ anyambi bʋtamawú, ɩnʋ ogyá ɛ́ ɩtamadun.
“Tsúfɛ́ bɔ́pʋ ogyá tɩn ɔhagyíɔha ɩwɩ, fɛ́ alɩá bʋtɔpʋ́ nfɔ́lɩ tɩn afɔdɩɛ ɩwɩ.
“Nfɔ́lɩ bʋ ɔdwɛ, támɛ nɩ́ ɩtá ɔdwɛ á, ntɔ bɛ́lapʋ́wá mʋ́ ɔdwɛ? “Mlɩha ɔdwɛ itsia mlɩtɔ fɛ́ nfɔ́lɩ, iwilwii itsia mlɩa mlɩ aba nsɩnɛ́.”
